subject: RelayX decommission notice — data export & DPA amendment checklist
messages:
From: Alan White <alan.white@edgecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeCloud Legal <legal@edgecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: RelayX decommission timeline and export window

Hi Kimberly,

We wanted to give you early notice that EdgeCloud is planning to decommission our RelayX telemetry/relaying service on 2028-08-15. RelayX currently processes telemetry and transient routing metadata for several downstream partners; we understand Redwood uses it for short-lived observability forwarding in the EU region.

Before we proceed we need to confirm two things with your team:
- Any objections to the decommission (compatibility, breakage)
- Whether you require a data export or continuity path for any processed data (we can provide a 30-day export window and a CSV mapping of retained fields)

Attached is a preliminary decommission notice; legal asked that we confirm any DPA / subprocessor amendments that might be required. If you can confirm by end of next week that Redwood either: (a) has no dependency, or (b) needs an export + DPA amendment, that would help our schedule.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

—Alan
Alan White
Strategic Partnerships, EdgeCloud
alan.white@edgecloud.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX

Attachments: relayx-notice-20280705.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Notice: RelayX decommission timeline and export window

Folks — forwarding notice from EdgeCloud (below). Quick assessment: RelayX is listed as an observability relay in our EU telemetry routing table (non-authoritative), used by the agent-metrics pipeline for a subset of small customers.

Action items I want to close before replying:
1) Confirm whether any active tenants (esp. Financial or EEA-resident) have exports or retention tied to RelayX.
2) Validate if any downstream contract or DPA references RelayX explicitly (procurement/legal).
3) If we need an export, request the CSV mapping + a 30-day export window; prepare a DPA amendment (short addendum) and a test to verify exported data contains only non-PII telemetry.

I've attached a short checklist we can send to EdgeCloud to standardize their response. Rishi — can you run a quick routing query and confirm which tenant IDs saw RelayX in the past 90 days? Marissa — can you search contract metadata for RelayX references and flag anything that looks like an explicit dependency?

I'll draft the initial reply once we have both answers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: relayx-decom-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: RelayX decommission timeline and export window

Kimberly / Rishi — quick updates inline.

- Contract search: I queried our contract metadata (search terms: "RelayX", "Relay X", "EdgeCloud Relay"). Found two older pilot addenda referencing RelayX by name tied to onboarding pilots from 2025. Both are for non-financial SMB tenants that we historically routed through RelayX for dev telemetry. I flagged the two pilots in the contract system (IDs: CN-20250713-PILOT-A, CN-20251102-PILOT-B).

- Tenant impact: Preliminary scan of routing logs shows ~7 tenant IDs with last RelayX activity in the past 90 days; most are low-throughput (dev/test). I've exported the list and attached a mapping (relayx-export-mapping.csv) with tenant_id, last_seen, and retention_flag. None of the tenant_ids appear to be EEA-financial customers — I cross-checked with account tagging.

Next steps I recommend:
- Ask EdgeCloud for the CSV export of fields they retain so we can verify schema (PII vs telemetry).
- Offer them a 30-day export window but request confirmation they will securely delete any retained buffers after the export period.
- Prepare a short DPA addendum template limited to the RelayX export window and deletion attestation; legal can re-use across partners.

Attaching mapping and my quick notes.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: RelayX decommission timeline and export window

Alan — thanks for the heads up and for including legal. We did a quick internal review and here is our position and requested next steps.

Summary: RelayX is used for a limited set of non-enterprise tenants (dev/test) in our EU routing table. No enterprise DPAs we reviewed reference RelayX explicitly. However, we would like to take a short export to validate schema and confirm no retained PII.

Requested actions from EdgeCloud:
1) Provide the CSV export of retained fields and a sample schema by 2028-07-12 (we will review against our telemetry policy).
2) Confirm you will provide a 30-day download window starting no earlier than 2028-08-01 and that all retained RelayX buffers will be securely deleted within 7 days of the window closing.
3) Sign a brief DPA addendum limited to the RelayX export window and deletion attestation. To speed this, we've prepared an addendum template and uploaded it for signature: https://app.docusign.com/relayx-dpa-amend (DocuSign link).

We do not object to the decommission provided the export + deletion attestation are in place. If EdgeCloud prefers, we can also run a coordinated cutover test (10 min window) to confirm there is no active routing disruption for the affected tenants.

Please confirm the points above and share the schema CSV. Once we get that, Legal prefers a short review (48 hrs) of the addendum.

Thanks — and feel free to assign a short call if helpful.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference
